camel_example: aliyun rds ImportUserBackupFile --region cn-hangzhou --BackupFile 'Bucket_:_test_,_Object_:_test/test_db_employees.xb_,_Location_:_ap-southeast-1' --Comment BackupTest --EngineVersion '5.7' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --SourceInfo 'sourceIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_sourcePort_:_9999' --BuildReplication true --Mode oss --Retention 30 --MasterInfo 'masterIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_masterPort_:_3306_,_masterUser_:_replica_,_masterPassword_:_W33uopkehBQ=' --BucketRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RestoreSize 20
description_en: This API is used to import backup data from a self-managed MySQL 5.7 database into RDS
description_zh: 该接口用于将自建库MySQL 5.7的备份数据导入至RDS
kebab_example: aliyun rds import-user-backup-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode oss --engine-version 5.7 --bucket-region cn-hangzhou --backup-file Bucket_:_test_,_Object_:_test/test_db_employees.xb_,_Location_:_ap-southeast-1 --comment BackupTest --restore-size 20 --retention 30 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --source-info sourceIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_sourcePort_:_9999 --build-replication true --master-info masterIp_:_172.20.xx.xx_,_masterPort_:_3306_,_masterUser_:_replica_,_masterPassword_:_W33uopkehBQ= --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportUserBackupFile

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

The value of this parameter is the ID of the region in which you want to create the instance.
The value of this parameter must be consistent with the value of BucketRegion
parameters.help_zh:
RDS地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

本参数的值为您希望创建RDS实例的地域ID。
需要和BucketRegion参数的值保持一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Import mode. Valid values:

oss: Download the backup from OSS and import it.
stream: Import the backup over the network
parameters.help_zh:
导入模式，取值说明：

oss：从OSS下载备份导入。
stream：通过网络导入备份
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The version of the database engine that is run on the self-managed MySQL database and ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance. Set the value to 5.7
parameters.help_zh: MySQL数据库的版本号。当前支持传入5.7或8.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the OSS bucket where the full backup file of the self-managed MySQL database is located. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 自建MySQL 5.7备份文件所在OSS Bucket的地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: bucket_region

parameters.help_en:
A JSON array that consists of the information about the full backup file stored as an object in an OSS bucket. Example: `{"Bucket":"test", "Object":"test/test_db_employees.xb","Location":"ap-southeast-1"}`

The JSON array contains the following fields:

Bucket: The name of the OSS bucket in which the full backup file is stored as an object. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31965.html operation to query the name of the bucket.
Object: The path of the full backup file that is stored as an object in the OSS bucket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31980.html operation to query the path of the object.
Location: The ID of the region in which the OSS bucket is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31967.html operation to query the region of the bucket
parameters.help_zh:
描述OSS Bucket中备份文件信息的JSON数组。示例：
`{"Bucket":"test", "Object":"test/test_db_employees.xb","Location":"ap-southeast-1"}`

数组中各参数的说明如下：
Bucket：备份文件所在OSS Bucket的名称。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31965.html获取。
Object：备份文件所在目录的详细路径。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31980.html获取。
Location：OSS Bucket所在地域的ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31967.html获取
parameters.name: backup_file

parameters.help_en: The description of the full backup file
parameters.help_zh: 要导入的用户备份的备注信息
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The amount of storage that is required to restore the data of the full backup file. Unit: GB.

The default value of this parameter is 5 times the size of the full backup file.
The minimum value of this parameter is 20
parameters.help_zh:
还原用户备份所需存储空间大小。单位：GB。

默认为备份文件的5倍大小。
最小值为20
parameters.name: restore_size

parameters.help_en: The retention period of the full backup file. Unit: days. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 用户备份文件保留时长。单位：天。取值为大于0的Integer类型整数
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

If you specify this parameter, the system creates a snapshot in single-digit seconds, which greatly reduces the time that is required to import the full backup file.
When you call the CreateDBInstance operation to create an instance by using the full backup file, the instance is created in the zone that you specify for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions查询。

设置可用区后，系统会在该可用区内创建一个秒级快照，大幅节省备份导入所需要的时间。
调用CreateDBInstance使用用户备份创建新实例时，该可用区即为新实例所在的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
A case-sensitive JSON array that provides the source information for a full backup. Example:

```
{"sourceIp":"172.20.xx.xx","sourcePort":"9999"}
```

The parameters in the array are described as follows:

`sourceIp`: Source IP address.

`sourcePort`: Port on which Netcat listens at the source.

This applies only to native replication instances and requires the `DBInstanceId` parameter to be passed when invoking the API
parameters.help_zh:
提供全量备份的源端信息的JSON数组（大小写敏感）。示例：

```
{"sourceIp":"172.20.xx
.xx","sourcePort":"9999"}

```

数组中各参数的说明如下：

`sourceIp`：源端IP。

`sourcePort`：源端Netcat监听的端口。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: source_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically set up replication. Valid values:
true: Yes. The `MasterInfo` parameter is required.
false: No.

This applies only to native replication instances and requires the `DBInstanceId` parameter to be passed when invoking the API
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动搭建复制，取值说明：
true：是，`MasterInfo`参数必填。
false：否。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: build_replication

parameters.help_en:
A case-sensitive JSON array containing the Master information for setting up MySQL replication. Example:

```
{"masterIp":"172.20.xx.xx","masterPort":"3306","masterUser":"replica","masterPassword":"W33uopkehBQ="}
```

The parameters in the array are described as follows:
`masterIp`: Primary database IP address.
`masterPort`: Primary database port.
`masterUser`: Replication account for the primary database.
`masterPassword`: Password for the replication account of the primary database, which must be Base64-encoded.

This applies only to native replication instances and requires the `DBInstanceId` parameter to be passed when invoking the API
parameters.help_zh:
搭建MySQL复制的Master信息的JSON数组（大小写敏感）。示例：

```
{"masterIp":"172.20.xx.xx","masterPort":"3306","masterUser":"replica","masterPassword":"W33uopkehBQ="}

```

数组中各参数的说明如下：
`masterIp`：主库IP。
`masterPort`：主库端口。
`masterUser`：主库复制账号。
`masterPassword`：主库复制账号密码，需要进行Base64加密。

仅对原生复制实例生效，需要在调用API时传入`DBInstanceId`参数
parameters.name: master_info

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the full backup file

Status.description_en: Indicates whether the full backup file is successfully imported into the instance. If the full backup file is successfully imported, true is returned. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Status.description_zh: 导入用户备份是否成功。是则返回true，否则返回错误信息
